empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill or import one from a .md file or a .zip archive.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview and edit it.

card.stats: {agents, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} · {pull} pull · {accept} accept

panel.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? It is removed from every agent that uses it.

form.title: Configuration
form.name: Name
form.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface: the agent reads it to decide when the rules apply. Write it as a directive — "Flag …", "Check that …", "Use when …".
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag new branches and edge cases that no test covers.
form.bodyHint: Plain instructions only. The text is added to the agent's prompt; nothing in it is executed.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Upload a .md file or a .zip skill package. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.trustTitle: You are adding someone else's instructions
import.trustBody: An imported skill becomes part of your agents' prompt. Read the whole body before saving — a malicious skill can steer reviews (e.g. tell the agent to ignore a class of bugs).
import.fileHint: .md or .zip, up to 512 KB. From an archive only SKILL.md is read; scripts and other files are never extracted or run.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 512 KB.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

stats.agentsEmpty: No agent has this skill enabled.
stats.categoriesEmpty: No findings attributed to this skill in the last {days} days.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the skill so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? A new version is created with its content; history is kept.
versions.diffSubtitle: Lines removed since v{version} are red; lines added since are green.
versions.noChanges: The body is identical to the current version.
